description.zh: 通话ID。您可以在[SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId。
description.en: Call ID. You can get the CallId from the response of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) operation.

description.zh: 接收视频播放的手机号码。
description.en: Mobile phone number that receives the video playback.

description.zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID。最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节。
description.en:
A custom ID for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the callback message.

This is a string of 1 to 15 bytes.

description.zh: 跳转到对应的时间播放视频，单位：毫秒。
description.en: Time in milliseconds to skip to for video playback.

descriptions.zh: 目前5G视频通话功能处于邀约制阶段，您需要联系运营经理为您开通此功能。
descriptions.en: The 5G video call feature is currently available by invitation only. Contact your account manager to enable this feature.
